'''Manfredo Perdigão do Carmo''' (15 August 1928, [[Maceió]] – 30 April 2018, [[Rio de Janeiro]]) was a Brazilian [[mathematician]]. He spent most of his career at [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]] and is seen as the doyen of [[differential geometry]] in Brazil.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Gorodski|first1=Claudio|last2=Piccione|first2=Paolo|date=2021-06-01|title=Opening note: An homage to Manfredo P. do Carmo|journal=São Paulo Journal of Mathematical Sciences|language=en|volume=15|issue=1|pages=1–2|doi=10.1007/s40863-020-00194-0|s2cid=228984989|issn=2316-9028|doi-access=free}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Do Carmo studied [[civil engineering]] at the [[University of Recife]] from 1947 to 1951. After working a few years as engineer, he accepted a teaching position at the newly created Institute of Physics and Mathematics at Recife.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last=Queiroz|first=Antonio José Melo de|date=2020|title=O percurso profissional de Manfredo Perdigão do Carmo e a geometria differencial no Brasil|trans-title=The professional path of Manfredo Perdigão do Carmo and differential geometry in Brazil|url=https://revistas.uece.br/index.php/BOCEHM/article/view/2819|journal=Boletim Cearense de Educação e História da Matemática|language=pt|volume=7|issue=20|pages=266–276|doi=10.30938/bocehm.v7i20.2819|s2cid=225625329|issn=2447-8504|doi-access=free}}</ref>

On suggestion of [[Elon Lages Lima|Elon Lima]], in 1959 he went to [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]] (IMPA) to improve his background<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Citation|last=Carmo|first=Manfredo P. do|chapter=A Summary of the Scientific Activities|date=2012|chapter-url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-25588-5_1|title=Manfredo P. do Carmo – Selected Papers|pages=1–5|editor-last=do Carmo|editor-first=Manfredo P.|place=Berlin, Heidelberg|publisher=Springer|language=en|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-25588-5_1|isbn=978-3-642-25588-5|access-date=2022-01-31|editor2-last=Tenenblat|editor2-first=Keti|chapter-url-access=subscription}}</ref> and in 1960 he moved to the US to pursue a Ph.D. in mathematics at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] under the supervision of [[Shiing-Shen Chern]]. He defended his thesis ''The Cohomology Ring of Certain Kahlerian Manifolds'' in 1963.<ref name="MGP">{{mathgenealogy|id=31508}}</ref>

After working again at [[University of Recife]] and at the [[University of Brasília|University of Brasilia]], in 1966 he became professor at IMPA in [[Rio de Janeiro]]. From 2003 to his death he was [[Emeritus|emeritus professor]] at the same institution.<ref name=":0" />

Do Carmo was a [[Guggenheim Fellowships|Guggenheim Fellow]] in [[List of Guggenheim Fellowships awarded in 1965|1965]] and [[List of Guggenheim Fellowships awarded in 1968|1968]].<ref name="gug">[https://web.archive.org/web/20150113232909/http://www.gf.org/fellows/2288-manfredo-perdigao-do-carmo Biography from the Guggenheim Foundation]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=John Simon Guggenheim Foundation {{!}} Manfredo Perdigao do Carmo|url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/manfredo-perdigao-do-carmo/|access-date=2022-01-31|language=en-US}}</ref> In 1978 he was [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers#1978, Helsinki|invited speaker]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] held in [[Helsinki]].<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://www.mathunion.org/fileadmin/ICM/Proceedings/ICM1978.1/ICM1978.1.ocr.pdf|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematician 1978|year=1980|editor-last=Lehto|editor-first=Olii|editor-link=Olli Lehto|location=Helsinki|pages=401}}</ref><ref>{{citation|last=do Carmo|first=Manfredo P.|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians (Helsinki, 1978)|pages=401–405|year=1980|contribution=Minimal surfaces: stability and finiteness|publisher=Acad. Sci. Fennica, Helsinki|mr=562633}}.</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=Carmo|first=Manfredo P. do|chapter=Minimal Surfaces: Stability and Finiteness|date=2012|chapter-url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-25588-5_12|title=Manfredo P. do Carmo – Selected Papers|pages=139–143|editor-last=do Carmo|editor-first=Manfredo P.|place=Berlin, Heidelberg|publisher=Springer|language=en|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-25588-5_12|isbn=978-3-642-25588-5|access-date=2022-02-01|editor2-last=Tenenblat|editor2-first=Keti|chapter-url-access=subscription}}</ref> In 1991 he obtained a Doctorate ''[[honoris causa]]'' from [[Federal University of Alagoas]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ufal promove evento internacional na área de Matemática|trans-title=Ufal promotes international event in an area of mathematics|url=https://ufal.br/ufal/noticias/2014/03/ufal-promove-evento-internacional-na-area-de-matematica|access-date=2022-02-07|website=Universidade Federal de Alagoas|date=12 March 2014 |language=pt-br}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Alagoano referência em geometria diferencial será homenageado em evento|trans-title=Alagoan reference in differential geometry will be homaged in an event|url=https://ufal.br/ufal/noticias/2018/6/alagoano-referencia-em-geometria-diferencial-sera-homenageado-em-evento|access-date=2022-02-07|website=Universidade Federal de Alagoas|date=8 June 2018 |language=pt-br}}</ref> and in 2012 from [[University of Murcia]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Professor Manfredo P. Do Carmo will be awarded the honorary degree Doctor Honoris Causa by the Universidad de Murcia {{!}} European Mathematical Society|url=https://euro-math-soc.eu/news/12/02/28/professor-manfredo-p-do-carmo-will-be-awarded-honorary-degree-doctor-honoris-causa|access-date=2022-02-01|website=euro-math-soc.eu}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|title=Laudatio del Padrino|date=2012-05-15|url=https://tv.um.es/video?id=35671&idioma=es&serie=8281&autoplay|language=es|access-date=2022-02-06}}</ref> and from [[Federal University of Amazonas]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ata da sessão solene de outorga de titulo Dr. Honoris Causa|trans-title=Acts of the solemn session to grant the title of Dr. Honoris Causa|url=https://conselhos.ufam.edu.br/images/atas/ata-da-sessao-solene-de-outorga-de-titulo-dr-honoris-causa-18072012-consuni.pdf|language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Resolução N° 009/2012|url=https://conselhos.ufam.edu.br/images/deliberacoes/res0092012suni-.pdf|language=pt}}</ref>

He served as president of the [[Brazilian Mathematical Society]] in the term 1971–1973.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Diretorias Anteriores – SBM – Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática|url=https://sbm.org.br/diretorias-anteriores/|access-date=2022-01-31|language=pt-BR}}</ref> He was elected a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]] in 1970,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Manfredo Perdigão do Carmo – ABC|url=https://www.abc.org.br/membro/manfredo-perdigao-do-carmo/|access-date=2022-01-31|language=pt-BR}}</ref> a member of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS) in 1997<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=do Carmo, Manfredo P.|url=https://twas.org/directory/do-carmo-manfredo-p|access-date=2022-01-31|website=TWAS|language=en}}</ref> and a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2013.<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-01-13.</ref>

Among his awards, he received the [[Prêmio Almirante Álavaro Alberto]] from the [[National Council for Scientific and Technological Development]] in 1984,<ref>{{Cite web|title=CNPq - Prêmio Almirante Álvaro Alberto|url=http://www.premioalvaroalberto.cnpq.br/laureados.html|access-date=2022-02-01|website=www.premioalvaroalberto.cnpq.br|language=pt}}</ref> the [[List of TWAS Prize laureates#Mathematics|TWAS Prize in Mathematics]] in 1992,<ref name=":2"/><ref name="Prizes and Awards">{{Cite web|date=2016|title=Prizes and Awards|url=https://twas.org/opportunities/prizes-and-awards|publisher=The World Academy of Sciences}}</ref> the [[National Order of Scientific Merit#Mathematics|National Order of Scientific Merit]] in 1995<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ordem Nacional do Mérito Científico|date=11 August 2023 |url=https://canalciencia.ibict.br/quem-somos2/noticias/item/237-ordem-nacional-do-merito-cientifico|publisher={{interlanguage link|Instituto Brasileiro de Informação em Ciência e Tecnologia|pt}}|language=pt}}</ref> and the ''Comenda Graciliano Ramos'' from the municipality of [[Maceió]] in 2000.

Do Carmo died on 30 April 2018 at the age of 89.<ref>{{cite web|title=Matemático Manfredo do Carmo morre aos 89 anos|trans-title=Mathematician Manfredo do Carmo dies at age 89|url=https://impa.br/page-noticias/matematico-manfredo-do-carmo-morre-aos-89-anos/|access-date=1 May 2018|publisher=[[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]]|language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Decease of Prof. Do Carmo {{!}} European Mathematical Society|url=https://euro-math-soc.eu/news/18/05/2/decease-prof-do-carmo|access-date=2022-01-31|website=euro-math-soc.eu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=News from the AMS|url=https://www.ams.org/news?news_id=4325|access-date=2022-01-31|website=American Mathematical Society|language=en}}</ref>

== Research ==
Do Carmo's main research interests were [[Riemannian manifold|Riemannian geometry]] and the [[differential geometry of surfaces]].<ref name=":1" />

In particular, he worked on [[Rigidity (mathematics)|rigidity]] and convexity of [[isometric immersion]]s,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=do Carmo|first1=M. P.|last2=Warner|first2=F. W.|date=1970|title=Rigidity and convexity of hypersurfaces in spheres|journal=Journal of Differential Geometry|volume=4|issue=2|doi=10.4310/jdg/1214429378|issn=0022-040X|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=doCarmo|first1=Manfredo P.|last2=Lima|first2=Elon|date=1969-05-01|title=Isometric immersions with semi-definite second quadratic forms|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01899010|journal=Archiv der Mathematik|language=en|volume=20|issue=2|pages=173–175|doi=10.1007/BF01899010|s2cid=189777457|issn=1420-8938|url-access=subscription}}</ref> stability of [[hypersurface]]s<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barbosa|first1=João Lucas|last2=do Carmo|first2=Manfredo|date=1984-09-01|title=Stability of hypersurfaces with constant mean curvature|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01215045|journal=[[Mathematische Zeitschrift]]|language=en|volume=185|issue=3|pages=339–353|doi=10.1007/BF01215045|s2cid=186222313|issn=1432-1823|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barbosa|first1=J. Lucas|last2=do Carmo|first2=Manfredo|last3=Eschenburg|first3=Jost|date=1988-03-01|title=Stability of hypersurfaces of constant mean curvature in Riemannian manifolds|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01161634|journal=Mathematische Zeitschrift|language=en|volume=197|issue=1|pages=123–138|doi=10.1007/BF01161634|s2cid=186231004|issn=1432-1823|url-access=subscription}}</ref> and of [[minimal surface]]s,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barbosa|first1=J. L.|last2=Carmo|first2=M. Do|date=1976|title=On the Size of a Stable Minimal Surface in R3|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2373899|journal=American Journal of Mathematics|volume=98|issue=2|pages=515–528|doi=10.2307/2373899|jstor=2373899|issn=0002-9327|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=do Carmo|first1=M.|last2=Peng|first2=C. K.|date=1979|title=Stable complete minimal surfaces in 𝑅³ are planes|url=https://www.ams.org/bull/1979-01-06/S0273-0979-1979-14689-5/|journal=Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society|language=en|volume=1|issue=6|pages=903–906|doi=10.1090/S0273-0979-1979-14689-5|issn=0273-0979|doi-access=free}}</ref> [[topology]] of [[manifold]]s,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=do Carmo|first1=Manfredo|last2=Xia|first2=Changyu|date=2000-02-01|title=Ricci curvature and the topology of open manifolds|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/s002080050018|journal=Mathematische Annalen|language=en|volume=316|issue=2|pages=391–400|doi=10.1007/s002080050018|s2cid=189881132|issn=1432-1807|url-access=subscription}}</ref> [[isoperimetric problem]]s,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barbosa|first1=João Lucas|last2=Carmo|first2=Manfredo do|date=1978-10-01|title=A proof of a general isoperimetric inequality for surfaces|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01186367|journal=Mathematische Zeitschrift|language=en|volume=162|issue=3|pages=245–261|doi=10.1007/BF01186367|s2cid=186236970|issn=1432-1823|url-access=subscription}}</ref> [[minimal submanifold]]s of a [[sphere]],<ref>{{Citation|last1=Chern|first1=S. S.|chapter=Minimal Submanifolds of a Sphere with Second Fundamental Form of Constant Length|date=1970|chapter-url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-48272-4_2|title=Functional Analysis and Related Fields: Proceedings of a Conference in honor of Professor Marshall Stone, held at the University of Chicago, May 1968|pages=59–75|editor-last=Browder|editor-first=Felix E.|place=Berlin, Heidelberg|publisher=Springer|language=en|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-48272-4_2|isbn=978-3-642-48272-4|access-date=2022-02-01|last2=do Carmo|first2=M.|last3=Kobayashi|first3=S.|chapter-url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Carmo|first1=Manfredo P. Do|last2=Wallach|first2=Nolan R.|date=1971|title=Minimal Immersions of Spheres into Spheres|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/1970752|journal=Annals of Mathematics|volume=93|issue=1|pages=43–62|doi=10.2307/1970752|jstor=1970752|issn=0003-486X|url-access=subscription}}</ref> and manifolds of constant [[mean curvature]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=do Carmo|first1=Manfredo P.|last2=Dajczer|first2=Marcos|date=1982-01-01|title=Helicoidal surfaces with constant mean curvature|journal=Tohoku Mathematical Journal|volume=34|issue=3|doi=10.2748/tmj/1178229204|s2cid=109931575 |issn=0040-8735|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Carmo|first1=M. Do|last2=Dajczer|first2=M.|date=1983|title=Rotation Hypersurfaces in Spaces of Constant Curvature|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/1999231|journal=Transactions of the American Mathematical Society|volume=277|issue=2|pages=685–709|doi=10.2307/1999231|jstor=1999231|issn=0002-9947|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Alencar|first1=Hilário|last2=do Carmo|first2=Manfredo|date=1994|title=Hypersurfaces with constant mean curvature in spheres|url=https://www.ams.org/proc/1994-120-04/S0002-9939-1994-1172943-2/|journal=Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society|language=en|volume=120|issue=4|pages=1223–1229|doi=10.1090/S0002-9939-1994-1172943-2|issn=0002-9939|doi-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Bérard|first1=P.|last2=do Carmo|first2=M.|last3=Santos|first3=W.|date=1998-06-01|title=Complete Hypersurfaces with Constant Mean Curvature and Finite Total Curvature|url=https://doi.org/10.1023/A:1006542723958|journal=Annals of Global Analysis and Geometry|language=en|volume=16|issue=3|pages=273–290|doi=10.1023/A:1006542723958|s2cid=189898400|issn=1572-9060|url-access=subscription}}</ref> and vanishing [[scalar curvature]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Barbosa|first1=J. L. M.|last2=Carmo|first2=M. P. Do|date=2005-09-01|title=On Stability of Cones in Rn+1 with Zero Scalar Curvature|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/s10455-005-0039-5|journal=Annals of Global Analysis and Geometry|language=en|volume=28|issue=2|pages=107–122|doi=10.1007/s10455-005-0039-5|s2cid=122198627|issn=1572-9060|url-access=subscription}}</ref>

Do Carmo published more than 100 papers in peer-reviewed journals;<ref>{{Cite web|title=zbMATH Open - the first resource for mathematics|url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:do-carmo.manfredo-perdigao|access-date=2022-02-01|website=zbmath.org}}</ref> in 2012 a selection of his works was published by [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]].<ref>{{Cite book|last=do Carmo|first=Manfredo P.|editor1-first=Keti|editor1-last=Tenenblat|date=2012|title=Manfredo P. do Carmo – Selected Papers|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-25588-5|language=en-gb|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-25588-5|isbn=978-3-642-25587-8}}</ref> He is  also known for his textbooks:<ref>{{Cite journal|last=do Carmo|first=Manfredo P.|date=1994|title=Differential Forms and Applications|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-57951-6|journal=Universitext|language=en-gb|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-57951-6|isbn=978-3-540-57618-1|issn=0172-5939|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last=Carmo|first=Manfredo Perdigão do|title=Riemannian geometry|date=1992|publisher=Birkhäuser|others=Francis J. Flaherty|isbn=0-8176-3490-8|location=Boston|oclc=24667701}}</ref> they were translated into many languages and used in courses from universities such as [[Harvard University|Harvard]] and [[Columbia University|Columbia]].<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=z_BNPYRNmyYC&pg=PA358|title=Prelúdio para uma história: ciência e tecnologia no Brasil|publisher=EdUSP|year=2004|isbn=978-85-314-0797-0|editor=Shozo Motoyama|page=358|language=pt|trans-title=Prelude for a story: science and technology in Brazil}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

He supervised 27 PhD students, including [[Celso Costa]], [[Marcos Dajczer]] and [[Keti Tenenblat]].<ref name="MGP" />
